answer: A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a fleet in one epoch however much capital it holds, since each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The jade cap is applied at intake and thread reveals the per-origin counts. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a yarrow tag. The deposit is 9 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
